thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate + CUDA OOMs in dedicated-us-west-3 (pool rg-3). Symptoms: cudaMalloc failures, KV cache fragmentation spike. Incident INC-20260315-09.
alex: Paging runtime + oncall. I'll coordinate mitigation.
maria: grabbing logs from rg-3 now. Seeing repeated traces: 
```
[2026-03-15T09:02:12Z] ERROR runtime.worker: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T09:02:12Z] WARN runtime.kv_cache: arena=3 frag_ratio=0.89 alloc=24MB
[2026-03-15T09:02:13Z] ERROR runtime.batch: cannot append request: allocation error
```
maria: fragmentation jumped from ~0.28 -> 0.88 in ~3m post-deploy. Lots of sub-64-token batches creating tiny KV allocations.
jamal: quick context: yesterday's micro-optim to reduce latency changed continuous_batch_window_ms=6 and max_tokens to 64 for interactive routing. Hypothesis: increased allocation churn + small free-chunks -> CUDA allocator fragmentation -> OOMs on large token requests.
eva: customer impact: p99 latency up, 5xx rate +4% on rg-3. Two customers (searchify-prod, longcontext-beta) reported errors/timeouts for >2k token calls. Not full outage but degraded.
alex: immediate mitigations to try (short list):
- disable continuous batching on rg-3 to stop churn
- set TORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF to increase max_split_size_mb (reduce split behavior)
- trigger targeted KV eviction/compaction for nodes with frag_ratio > 0.7
- rolling restart small batches of hosts (10-25% at a time)
- monitor client errors and latency
maria: executing now: 
```
# turn off continuous batching for pool rg-3
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/pools/rg-3/config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" -d '{"continuous_batching":false}'
# set allocator conf and restart runtime deployment (gradual)
kubectl set env deploy/runtime-prod TORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:128 -n runtime-prod
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-prod -n runtime-prod
```
jamal: we have an admin eviction endpoint. Starting canary eviction on 5 nodes:
```
POST https://admin.internal/kv/evict
{ "pool":"rg-3", "fragmentation_gt":0.7, "limit":5 }
```
jamal: canary eviction started. Will watch frag_ratio and OOMs.
eva: CS update: searchify-prod seeing ~6-8% error spike on long requests. Notified contacts and queued CS tickets.
ops-bot: DeployBot: rollout initiated by maria - staged restart 20% at a time.
maria: also pushed temporary allocator flags into runtime container: `--allocator-opts "max_split_size_mb=128,garbage_collect_delay_ms=2500"`. Hoping this reduces internal free-list fragmentation.
aj, not present: (typo)
jamal: early canary telemetry: frag_ratio on canary nodes dropped 0.92 -> 0.57, error rate down ~55% on those hosts.
alex: good. Keep continuous batching off on rg-3 until we verify for 1h. Prepare revert PR for the batch-window change.
jamal: opened PR to revert the interactive batch tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1264 (revert continuous_batch_window_ms change).
eva: SLO check: no company-wide SLO breached, but two customers' SLA error budgets exceeded for a 15m window. Severity remains P2 due to regional scope and limited customer impact. CS is handling comms.
jamal: logs from a failing host for context:

maria: canary restarts show improvement; rolling restart continuing. Frag ratios across the pool trending down now (avg 0.42).
alex: immediate actions summary:
- keep continuous batching disabled for rg-3 (monitor 1h)
- keep TORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF env and allocator opts for 24h minimum
- merge revert PR then promote to canary after stability confirmed
- add alerting for kv_cache.frag_ratio > 0.6
